item.text:
Yes. Use:

```http
DELETE https://api.mistral.ai/v1/agents/{agent_id}
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

Python SDK:

```python
mistral.beta.agents.delete(agent_id="<agent_id>")
```

See Mistral’s [Agents API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/agents) and [Agents & Conversations guide](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api).
